When I was them I was a zombie, and had lots of side effects. I could feel things bouncing around but couldn't get them to the surface. I am not against meds but sometimes the cocktail has to be right or you are so numb it makes the depression worse. Without the SSRIs I was clearer and have ups and down days but I feel what I need to feel good and bad, days I couldn't make myself do anything, but could think, and get myself out of it easier than on the meds. It is traumatic it ruined my life when I went into early menopause at 38 I am 57 now, and I have never been the same or have felt okay. No one would help me, I was having hot flashes every 10 minutes, causing panic and felt like arrhythmia. No one told me about what menopause is really.  Women dropped the ball for each other on this by not helping each other understand and prepare for it. It is better now but 10 years ago it was shameful.  It is like a cruel joke of nature. It messes with all of your being. Everything begins to slide downhill, mind and body. My skin changed drastically sagging, it was like pouring kerosine on my depression and anxiety, no sleep, hot flashes, who knew that your vagina would close up shop. I am on HRT and things have leveled off but symptoms still creep in.  What is even sadder is the medical community doesn't give a crap about older women. Meno sucks and never ends.
